tools_helpful.evidence: Preserved UWP .csproj at .uwp-source/ and mass-rewrote Windows.UI.Xaml -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml namespaces; the dev-agent built on top of the scaffold without re-deriving namespace mappings.
Final run reported '[PASS] dotnet build succeeded (0 warning(s), 0 WUI analyzer warning(s))', giving the agent a clear done-signal.

tools_problematic.problem: Step 1 (source-file copy) copies every *.cs recursively with no obj/bin exclusion, so stale UWP build artifacts are dragged into the new project.
tools_problematic.evidence: Copied tree contained app\ActivitySensor\Tasks\obj\x64\Release\.NETCore,Version=v5.0.AssemblyAttributes.cs (a UWP/.NETCore 5.0 artifact that the net10.0 build never generates) which then got globbed into the compile.

tool_limitations.limitation: Its obj/bin exclusion existed only in the namespace-rewrite step (excludeDirs), not in the file-copy step.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Apply the same bin/obj/.vs/.uwp-source/.git exclusion to the copy loop so stale artifacts never enter the target.

special_apis.special_handling: Background-task registration was wired with the WinAppSDK BackgroundTaskBuilder per MIGRATION-PATTERNS 'Background Tasks'; runtime outcome is gated by background-access + sensor policy on a sensorless machine, so it is not verifiable in the harness (flagged manual review, not a defect).

errors_encountered.root_cause: Stale UWP-era obj artifacts under the nested Tasks subfolder were copied into the project and compiled by the SDK default glob; the SDK only auto-excludes the project's own root obj/bin, not nested ones.
errors_encountered.fix: Exclude bin/obj from the source copy (durable). Dev-agent's reactive fix was <Compile Remove="Tasks\obj\**"/> which is scenario-specific.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Same nested stale-obj globbing produced a second set of assembly attributes colliding with the SDK auto-generated AssemblyInfo.
errors_encountered.fix: Same as above; alternatively DefaultItemExcludes=**/obj/**;**/bin/** and delete any carried-over Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Two consecutive failed builds (4 errors+1 warning, then 6 errors), all CS0579 duplicate-attribute, before success.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Stale nested obj/bin (.cs) artifacts copied from the UWP source and compiled by default globbing.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Added a scenario-specific <Compile Remove="Tasks\obj\**"/> ItemGroup to the csproj.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 excluding bin/obj/.vs/.git from the file-copy step (Tier-1 tooling), so the artifacts never reach the project.

env_issues.issue: Sensorless CI machine: ActivitySensor.GetDefaultAsync() returns null, so all 4 scenarios show the no-sensor message and Background 'Register Task' cannot be confirmed.
env_issues.workaround: Faithful to UWP behavior; scoring treats it as expected, not a defect.
